capabilityBindings.truthBoundary: The selected mature provider owns workload credential issuance and verification semantics.
Security owns capability authorization semantics; policy does not execute effects.
Host owns external semantic continuity; Gateway is only a routing projection.

stages.responsibility: Authenticate a first-party software workload without browser or Human interaction during ordinary operation.
Bind verified workload identity to a bounded capability decision.
Enforce the admitted decision and route to the natural owner without storing workload credentials.
Answer the bounded continuity request under Host-owned semantics.

gateRequirements.assumption: Security receives provider-verified workload identity and currentness evidence.
gateRequirements.guarantee: The workload identity provider does not require browser or Human callback in ordinary operation.
gateRequirements.supportScope: first-party workload identity verification seam only

gateRequirements.assumption: Gateway receives a bounded capability decision that it can enforce without owning policy semantics.
gateRequirements.guarantee: Security decision identity is bound to the verified workload and requested capability.
gateRequirements.supportScope: workload capability authorization enforcement seam only

gateRequirements.assumption: Host remains the semantic continuity owner.
gateRequirements.guarantee: Gateway performs routing/projection only and does not reinterpret Host truth.
gateRequirements.supportScope: Gateway continuity routing to Host truth boundary only

unresolvedAssumptions: No production workload identity provider is selected or live-bound for Gateway admission.
Public Gateway capability-scoped authorization is not yet implemented as a proven Security-to-Gateway enforcement seam.
nonClaims: This circuit does not deploy SPIFFE/SPIRE, mint credentials, or authorize a workload.
Workload admission does not require or imply a Human browser flow.
Authorization does not establish owner effect truth or domain completion.
